Bangkok Tree House
Bangkok Tree House is an eco-friendly accommodation in Bang Kachao, Phra Pradaeng District, perfect for nature lovers seeking a escape from the hustle and bustle of the city. Relax amidst nature, gaze at the lush greenery of the surrounding trees, and let time pass you by.
Cycle to find something to eat at Bang Nam Phueng Market, explore the local community, and enjoy a relaxing getaway. This resort is also a popular stop on the Bang Kachao cycling route. Cars are not accessible to this resort (drivers must park at Wat Bang Nam Phueng Nok or Wat Bang Na Nok). If you don't have a car, buses and ferries are convenient, as it's just a short distance from Bangkok across the Chao Phraya River.

View With A Room
This room is a dream for stargazers, featuring a rooftop terrace with a sitting area and an observatory in the open courtyard (with mosquito nets).
The rooftop is accessed via a spiral staircase to the top (not recommended for those with dizziness). This section features a circular, exposed bamboo balcony atop the treetops, a sitting area, and a bedroom with a mosquito netting in the outdoor courtyard, approximately 23 feet high. Guests staying in this room also have access to the Tree Top Nest.
